title: Control menu
description: The app's corner button: switch to another app, or edit, set up and connect this one.

openApp.label: Open an app
openApp.hint: Switches to the app pressed in the list.

createApp.label: New app

getApps.label: Apps

getIsOpen.label: Starts open
getIsOpen.hint: Whether the dropdown is open when drawn.
